decision: Baseline before any change
why: Check output reads as old vs new

decision: Link count in inode (extra_links u32 at offset 88), no back-reference records
why: No adapter consumes a file parent or its name list; back-refs double rename/swap logic in src/ and linux/
evidence: FUSE parent use only for directory "..": fuse/src/fs.rs:1039,1055,1891; no export ops in linux/

decision: Store links minus one, zero for single-link files
why: Existing inodes stay valid without rewrite (same idea as mode bit 15)
evidence: FORMAT.md section 5 inode table

decision: Feature bit 2 published before the link in userspace, with the link in the kernel
why: Matches how each engine already publishes preallocation
evidence: src/volume.rs:730 enable_preallocation; linux/write.rs:1429

decision: File parent becomes a hint; strict parent rule kept for directories and symlinks
why: After unlinking the parent-named entry no survivor can be found without a scan
evidence: FORMAT.md section 5 linked-inode paragraph

decision: Fixture link-catalog-leaf.bin
why: Byte-level vector for the new inode field and repeated entry targets
evidence: python3 spec/verify.py: 11 fixtures PASS

decision: Spec review gate: 2 reviewers (opus, sonnet); fable reviewer dropped per user
why: User asked for no fable agents and fewer subagents
evidence: Reviewer findings in session; consensus on 6 issues

decision: Act: file parent hint excluded from ancestry walk; hint only nonzero and below next ID
why: Both checkers would reject ln d1/f d2/g; rm d2/g; rmdir d2
evidence: src/check.rs:343,612-626; linux/check.rs:316-358 (both reviewers)

decision: Act: every directory entry lives in a linked directory
why: Without file ancestry nothing proves an entry sits in a reachable directory
evidence: Reviewer B finding 1

decision: Act: extra_links <= 65534, zero on non-files/orphans, needs bit 2; reserved zero from 92
why: A wrapping counter alone accepts extra=65535 with no entries
evidence: Both reviewers

decision: Act: feature bit 2 set inside the link transaction in both engines
why: Pre-publish let a failed ln (EEXIST) upgrade the volume and diverged from the kernel
evidence: Forest checks base.features only at src/tree.rs:1761,1778,1905

decision: Act: file-to-symlink conversion requires extra_links == 0; same-file rename guard runs after the no-replace collision
why: Windows reparse on a linked file would retype one of two entries; Linux returns EEXIST for NOREPLACE before vfs_rename
evidence: Reviewer C 5,7; Reviewer B 3

decision: Checker: keep 1-bit bitmap, add one 64-bit multiset hash for repeat entries instead of a u16 counter per ID
why: Constant memory; a u16 counter is 16x memory (128 MiB kernel mount window) or 16x catalog walks; an odd bijective hash always catches single-object and +-1 pair errors
evidence: linux/check.rs:13 WINDOW=2^26; src/check.rs:19

decision: Deferred to step 6: Windows same-object replace rename removes the source name; per-name WinFsp file nodes may cache two names separately
why: Adapter behavior, not format
evidence: Reviewer B 4, Reviewer C 6

decision: Noted: hard links to symlinks refused (EPERM); documented as a limitation
why: Windows adapter relies on one entry per symlink; YAGNI
evidence: Reviewer C 10

decision: Core: link replaces link_tmpfile; unlink/replace decrement; same-file rename and swap are no-ops
why: Spec section 5 semantics
evidence: src/volume/tests/links.rs: 8 tests incl. 65,535-link cap (0.47 s) and link/unlink crash cuts at every write+flush

decision: Feature bits travel in Forest drafts, marks and seal
why: Link publishes bit 2 atomically; a rewound batch op drops it
evidence: failed-link test leaves durable image byte-identical and bit clear; crash cuts show bit set iff second name exists

decision: Checker: bitmap + u128 link_hash sums; file parent hint not walked; entries only in linked directories
why: See step 1 decision
evidence: links.rs forgeries rejected: count too high, too low, single-link claim, swap between two objects, entry in orphaned directory

decision: link_hash is 2*mix(x)+1 in u128, not mix|1 in u64
why: mix|1 collides IDs differing in bit 0, breaking the pairwise guarantee
evidence: ondisk/src/format.rs link_hash

decision: Files oracle gains link op (op 12) and asserts links == name count after every op
why: Fuzz coverage of link interleavings with pins, crashes and renames
evidence: file_operations_match_their_oracle: scripted link sequence + 100 random inputs pass

decision: FUSE: link for any regular file (EPERM dir/symlink, EMLINK cap), nlink = attributes.links
why: Same engine semantics on Linux, macOS, FreeBSD
evidence: build01 Linux FUSE: fs::tests::hard_link_syscalls ok; macOS macFUSE: hardlinks.py --keep/--verify-kept across remount + carryfs check ok

decision: Windows: rewrite Open.path only for the renamed path when the file has other names; same-file replace rename removes the source; multi-name opens bypass the WinFsp cache
why: WinFsp keys file nodes and cached pages by name
evidence: windows tests 61 pass incl. renaming_one_name_of_a_linked_file_keeps_its_other_opens; ffi bypass path not run on real Windows

decision: Docs: INSTALLATION.md hard links + automatic upgrade; linux/README.md link(2)
why: Users must know older CarryFS cannot mount upgraded volumes
evidence: git diff INSTALLATION.md linux/README.md

decision: Kernel: link general case, nlink = extra+1, unlink/replace drop_nlink + decrement, validator ported (file hint, linked-directory entries, u128 link sums)
why: Same semantics as core; eviction removes only at nlink 0
evidence: build01 kernel 7.0.0-38 VM: check.py all checks passed incl. hard links phase (kernel-made links pass userspace check+scrub and kernel remount validator); roots.py + fuzz.py PASS; no kernel diagnostics; corrupt-records phase rejects directory cross-link with the new reason

decision: faults.py metadata phase failed once with "image is in use"
why: Device.close does not wait for async loop detach (check.py Volume.unmount does)
evidence: Rerun 3/3 PASS in fresh VM; not link-related

decision: build01 release carryfs-fuse was stale (--bin carryfs filtered it out); adapters.py link step hit old EPERM
why: Own build mistake, not a code defect
evidence: Rebuilt release carryfs-fuse; adapters.py + permissions.py rerun

decision: Spike macOS: clonefile ENOTSUP; cp -c, ditto --clone, fcopyfile(COPYFILE_CLONE) silently full-copy; no copy request reaches the macFUSE daemon
why: Decides whether APFS-like instant copy is reachable on macOS
evidence: scratchpad probe: carryfs-fuse with a logging copy_file_range on macFUSE 5.5.0

decision: Spike Windows: WinFsp volume FSCTL path forwards only reparse-point codes; FSCTL_DUPLICATE_EXTENTS_TO_FILE gets STATUS_INVALID_DEVICE_REQUEST
why: Decides Windows block cloning
evidence: winfsp/src/sys/fsctl.c FspFsvolFileSystemControl

decision: Spike Linux: kernel driver via remap_file_range (FICLONE, copy_file_range); FUSE via FUSE_COPY_FILE_RANGE opcode
why: Only platform where instant copy is reachable
evidence: Standard kernel interfaces; fuser exposes copy_file_range (lib.rs:1304)

decision: Cross-engine links: FUSE-made link mounts in kernel (same ino, nlink 2, validator accepts); kernel-made link passes userspace check+scrub
why: Two independent engines must agree on the format
evidence: build01 VM with rebuilt release carryfs-fuse: adapters.py PASS (extended with links), permissions.py PASS
